name: External Link Icon
description: Icon for external links and redirect actions with animated variations

variations.name: default
variations.description: On hover, the box fills with color and the arrow bounces diagonally up-right along its direction, then returns

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: color
props.description: Stroke and fill color of the icon (CSS color value)

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the SVG element

props.name: isHovered
props.description: Controls the fill and arrow animation. Manage this state in the parent via onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of the arrow nudge in seconds; the box fill scales with it

props.name: ease
props.description: Easing of the animation. Accepts a named ease or a cubic-bezier array.

props.name: fillOpacity
props.description: Opacity of the box fill on hover
